pin_title: 6 Kitchen Buys Under £25 UK Home Cooks Swear By

pin_hook: Small upgrades, big difference in the kitchen
pin_description: Kitchen buys UK home cooks rate highly: stackable storage containers, Pyrex glass mixing bowls, a ceramic utensil holder, oil sprayer, digital scale and garlic press.
